# Scope registry

Machine-readable form: `packages/contracts/src/catalog/scopes.json`. The human registry of record is
the "Roles and scopes" section of [SHARED-CONTRACTS](../SHARED-CONTRACTS.md); CI fails when a scope the
catalog uses is not registered there, when a name is not `noun.verb` (a dotless camel-case name such
as `receivablesRead`, a wildcard or an empty name is a defect), or when this page is stale.

A scope alone never authorizes: the policy table also checks the principal kind, the live membership,
the location, and each domain command checks the resource (and, for portal principals, the S5
relationship). "Human only" means every operation using the scope admits only human principals, so a
grant of it to a service or agent principal can never be exercised (the forbidden-operation matrix,
docs/api/forbidden-matrix.md, proves the refusal). There is no grant API for staff scopes yet;
memberships are administered outside the API, and the default role-to-scope grants remain an open
human decision (A-D2). No default role grant is asserted here.

## Relationship scopes (S5)

Evaluated by the relationship policy for portal principals and relationship holders; never staff scopes
and never admitted by the staff policy table: `demographics`, `scheduling`, `clinical_read`, `financial`, `consent`.
